text:
zoe: Heads-up: trying to run the JS SDK in a Deno Edge runtime and Bun. Hitting a runtime parse error from a node: import inside a built file. stack: 'Error: Cannot find module "node:crypto"' from dist/cjs/crypto-fallback.js. Anyone seen this?

peter: Yep. Usually resolver picked our CJS/node build. Deno can't parse CJS that references node: specifiers. Bun sometimes tolerates it but webcrypto shape differs.

anya: Repro?

zoe: Super tiny:
```ts
import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference';
const c = createClient({ apiKey: Deno.env.get('RW_KEY') });
await c.generate('testing');
```
Deno errors before runtime because it tries to parse CJS which imports node:crypto.

peter: Short-term hacks: add an import_map mapping node:crypto -> deno std shim, or import the ESM edge entry directly if we publish one. Long term we need package changes.

anya: What package changes do you propose?

zoe: My wishlist: (1) publish a distilled ESM/edge build that only uses web APIs, (2) set package.json exports so importers get the edge entry by default, (3) ship minimal ambient types so Deno TS doesn't force consumers to add DOM libs, (4) add CI smoke tests for deno and bun.

peter: Agree. For exports map use something like: { ".": { "import": "./dist/edge/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/node/index.cjs" } } That makes modern importers pick the ESM. Also make sure the ESM build contains no node: specifiers in its source maps.

anya: On types: Deno complains TS2339 when we call globalThis.crypto.subtle if their tsconfig doesn't include dom. We can ship a simple edge.d.ts that contains: 'declare global { var crypto: Crypto; }' plus any tiny interfaces we need. Point the ESM export to that types file.

zoe: Bun notes: Bun's fetch stream objects and global crypto sometimes have slightly different method names/structures. We should add tolerant runtime adapters: detect if body.getReader exists, else if body.stream or body[Symbol.asyncIterator] works, etc. And for crypto use: prefer globalThis.crypto?.subtle, fall back to globalThis.webcrypto?.subtle, then to a node shim only if running in node.

peter: Implementation sketch for streaming robustness: a small util normalizeStream(respBody) that returns a Web ReadableStream when possible and falls back to a simple async iterator wrapper for nonstandard streams. Keep it tiny so overhead is minimal.

anya: Also watch bundler resolution: esbuild/rollup can still pick wrong entry if exports isn't present. Add exports and test resolution with 'deno info' and 'bun --version' locally.

zoe: CI: add a matrix job that runs a tiny script under deno run and bun run: import package, call generate with a stubbed fetch handler (or mock fetch), assert no node imports and the call returns. Keep it opt-in on PRs touching sdk/build.

build-bot: Created task sdk/deno-bun-smoke, added to infra board.

peter: One more gotcha: source maps. If source maps in the edge build reference original files that import node-only modules, runtime stack traces in Deno will be confusing. Strip or rewrite source map sources to the edge build files.

anya: I can draft the edge.d.ts and a tiny README section 'Using in Deno/Bun' showing both a no-config path (import picks edge ESM) and a fallback import_map snippet. I'll open a PR and tag runtime and devex.

zoe: Thanks — will add repro and failing stack to the PR so reviewers can run it locally.
